invariant: fixed_mask/fixed_tokens must hold specified residues literal in sampled output
method: differential probe on tests/data/1ubq.pdb (76 residues), fixed positions [0,1,2] forced to 'I' via fixed_tokens, run on titanix CPU
summary: sample() correctly holds fixed positions at the requested identity via _prepare_fixed_controls (host/_sampling_helper.py); unconstrained run differs at 2 of 3 positions confirming the forcing is real, not coincidental.

invariant: fixed_mask should have some observable effect, or should refuse loudly if semantically meaningless for this surface
method: differential probe: score() called with fixed_mask=all-ones vs all-zeros on an identical sequences_to_score input, titanix CPU
summary: fixed_mask has zero measurable effect on score() output (bit-identical mean/std/sum). Silently accepted, does nothing -- same shape as prior audit's F002/F005 (silently discarded field). Semantics may legitimately be N/A for score() (a given sequence is already fully 'fixed' by definition), but the field is not rejected or documented as inert -- a caller has no signal.
blast: high (a caller who thinks fixed_mask restricts which positions contribute to the returned score gets no error and a wrong mental model of what was computed)
silence: high (bit-identical output, no warning, no exception)
closure_evidence: loud refusal (F002/F005-shaped, not real wiring): runner.score() now raises NotImplementedError naming fixed_mask when it has any nonzero entries, pointing at runner.sample as the surface that honours it. Chose refusal over guessing at masking semantics inside score.py's NLL path, which has documented history of nats-level leakage bugs from unverified changes (see score.py:145-172 comments). Regression tests in tests/host/test_fixed_mask_score_jacobian_guard.py; full tests/host/ suite re-run on titanix after the fix (387 passed, 10 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 new failures).

invariant: fixed_mask should have some observable effect, or should refuse loudly if semantically meaningless for this surface
method: differential probe: jacobian() called with fixed_mask=all-ones vs all-zeros, identical structure input, titanix CPU
summary: fixed_mask has zero measurable effect on categorical_jacobians output (bit-identical mean/std/sum/shape). Unlike score(), there is a plausible legitimate use (excluding fixed positions from the sensitivity/Jacobian calc) that is not merely N/A-by-definition -- this reads as a real gap, not just an inert-by-construction field.
blast: medium-high (a caller computing per-position sensitivity for a partially-fixed design gets sensitivities for positions they explicitly told the system were fixed, with no indication those are meaningless)
silence: high (bit-identical output, no warning, no exception)
closure_evidence: loud refusal (same shape as FA2): runner.jacobian() now raises NotImplementedError naming fixed_mask when it has any nonzero entries -- neither make_categorical_jacobian_fn nor make_reverse_jacobian_score_fn has a parameter for it. Real wiring (excluding fixed positions from the sensitivity computation) is deferred as an owner decision rather than guessed at here. Same regression-test + full-suite evidence as FA2.
